easyPrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with the other combo piece.
description:
Activate Marionette Master by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Marionette Master enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Marionette Master
Resolve the Marionette Master trigger, creating three artifact tokens.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two artifacts, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.
